_about: Order 14 LPV, V1 (owner, 17 Nov 2026; the lead's decision after review): a rule whose own subject is one of these things, on a paper that names none of its spellings on any page, is NOT dropped: its point moves to the section 'AI thinks these do not apply, tick to confirm' with the reason 'the paper names no <thing> on any page', and the engineer confirms. Read by app/rule_subject_fit.py.

Each entry is a construction, a material class, a part or an equipment kind that only SOME equipment has, with its spellings (synonyms included). A spelling must name the thing itself, never a property or a field ('design life', 'pressure').

A rule that REQUIRES the thing ('... shall be provided', the thing named after the verb) never moves: a missing required part is a finding. A negation near the thing, or a subject joining another group, keeps the rule as it is.
Generic: no standard, clause, document or layout is named. Engineer-editable data: add a line or a spelling, no code change.
